title: Best Razor Blades (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from the provided sources: Harry’s Plus Razor (source 4), Dollar Shave Club Humble Twin and Gillette Fusion ProShi (source 1), and Merkur Super Iridium (source 6).
assumptions: Prices are not included because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a man who wants a smooth shave without the high cost of premium brands. The Harry’s Plus Razor delivers a close shave with a comfortable handle and a durable blade, making it a solid choice for everyday use. Its main catch is that it may feel a bit heavier than some cartridge alternatives.
